annotatedSteps.description: Convert dimensions to centimetres and identify required measure as HCF
annotatedSteps.studentWork:
Length = 9.75 m = 975 cm, Breadth = 6.75 m = 675 cm, Height = 5.25 m = 525 cm
Longest ruler = HCF (975, 675, 525)

annotatedSteps.description: Calculate HCF by taking the product of the smallest powers of common prime factors
annotatedSteps.studentWork: HCF = 3³ × 5² = 675 (product of highest powers of common prime factors)
annotatedSteps.teacherAnnotation: × Conceptual error: HCF requires the smallest power of common factors (3¹ × 5²), not the highest
annotatedSteps.correctedWorking: HCF = 3¹ × 5² = 75 (product of smallest powers of common prime factors)

annotatedSteps.description: State the length of the longest ruler
annotatedSteps.teacherAnnotation: × Incorrect answer resulting from the earlier HCF definition error

teacherNote: Great job setting up the problem and finding the correct prime factorisations. Remember that HCF takes the lowest power of each common prime factor, whereas LCM takes the highest power.

rubric.point: Unit conversion and identifying required length as HCF(975, 675, 525)
Correct calculation of HCF using lowest powers of common prime factors
Final answer stating the length of the longest ruler with units (75 cm or 0.75 m)
